title.narrative: West Africa Competitiveness and Quality Infrastructure Project

description.narrative: The West Africa Competitiveness Program will be implemented under the 11th EDF of the Regional Indicative Plan (RIP) 2014-2020. The program includes regional and national components. This action includes the activities for the regional (ECOWAS/ UEMOA) component and is structured to promote regional linkages between private sector operators and organisations of the selected value chains, in order to optimise the quality infrastructure for those value chains and to improve the regional business environment.
